cases.name: A5-safety-margin-default
cases.why: A4 — default 10% margin; effectiveBudget = floor(budget * 0.9)

cases.name: A11-fractional-effective-budget-half
cases.why: pins the ROUNDING MODE of effectiveBudget. 95 * (1 - 10/100) = 85.5, where Math.floor (85) and Math.round (86) disagree. Without a fractional case the mode is unpinned and floor->round is a byte-invisible mutation, which an isolated review confirmed against the 47-case corpus.

cases.name: A12-fractional-effective-budget-below-half
cases.why: companion to A11 below the .5 point: 97 * 0.90 = 87.3, where floor and round agree but Math.ceil (88) would not. Guards the mutation A11 does not cover.

cases.name: A13-fractional-effective-budget-odd-margin
cases.why: third rounding guard at a non-multiple-of-10 margin: 93 * (1 - 15/100) = 79.05. Exercises the margin arithmetic itself, not just the budget, since safetyMarginPct is caller-supplied.

cases.name: A6-safety-margin-zero
cases.why: A5 — 0% margin means the full budget is usable

cases.name: A7-safety-margin-hundred
cases.why: A5 — 100% margin drives effectiveBudget to 0, forcing the min-set hard fail

cases.name: A8-budget-zero
cases.why: A6 — non-positive budget must hard-fail cleanly, never negative-length slice

cases.name: A9-budget-negative
cases.why: A6 — negative budget must not crash

cases.why: B7/row 10 — share falls BELOW the 1024-char floor so the floor wins, and the resulting total deliberately EXCEEDS the group budget. Budget 1100: min-set 5+5+4*256=1034 fits; groupBudget 992 => charsBudget 3968 => share 992 < 1024, so every plan is held at the floor. cases.name: B12-droppables-absent

cases.name: B13-droppables-empty-string
cases.why: B13/row 23 — empty-string droppables. Paired with B12 to pin whether "" and null are distinguished. They are NOT: applyBudget uses truthy checks throughout, so "" behaves as absent. This case records that fact rather than the design doc's claim that they differ.

cases.name: B13b-empty-string-droppable-under-pressure
cases.why: B13 companion — an empty-string droppable while the ladder is ACTIVELY running. Pins that "" is never recorded in omitted even under real pressure, which B12/B13 (no pressure) cannot show. research is real and IS dropped, so the ladder is demonstrably engaged.
